tasks.gr12-social-and-environmental-responsibi: Topic: Social and Environmental Responsibility. Cover social issues, environmental health, ethical responsibility, legislation awareness and realistic intervention strategies. Ask Grade 12 learners to analyse a current issue, connect it to rights and responsibilities, identify relevant laws or policies, or propose a practical response that promotes wellbeing and justice.
tasks.gr12-community-and-social-action-t2: Topic: Community and Social Action. Cover volunteerism, advocacy, support services, leadership, accountability and meaningful youth participation in community challenges. Ask learners to design an action plan, evaluate a social action case study, identify support services, or explain how leadership and accountability strengthen community work.
tasks.gr12-risk-management-and-support-t2: Topic: Risk Management and Support. Cover violence, poverty, substance abuse, trauma, coping strategies, protective factors and referral systems. Ask learners to analyse a risk scenario, identify support options, explain the effects of harmful social conditions, or evaluate responsible intervention choices that protect wellbeing.
tasks.gr12-physical-education-task-2-t2: Topic: Physical Education Task — Term 2. Cover game participation, teamwork, fitness goals, stress relief, safety and active lifestyle habits. Ask learners to reflect on participation, describe fair-play behaviour, connect physical activity to stress management, or set practical fitness goals for the term.
